claim.statement: The unordered entry pairs equal the last-put map.

adapter.mapping: A bijective base-three word of up to four String keys QED, R&D and X drives one builder. Each put uses its one-based position. Size, per-key lookup (zero means absent), and unordered entries are independently observed. Entry pairs are sorted by key and value after iteration.
